description: Model list prices in USD per 1M tokens, standard (non-batch, non-priority) tier, read from each provider's official pricing page. Used by bench/analyze.py to turn Inspect token usage into model cost. Keys are Inspect model ids exactly as they appear in log.eval.model.

token_conventions.input: Inspect ModelUsage.input_tokens: uncached input only (cache reads and writes are reported separately).
token_conventions.cache_write: Inspect input_tokens_cache_write. Anthropic: the 5-minute write rate (Inspect's default cache TTL).
token_conventions.reasoning: Every provider below bills reasoning/thinking tokens at the output rate. Inspect already counts them inside output_tokens for Anthropic, OpenAI, Google and OpenRouter; for xAI (grok provider) output_tokens excludes them. analyze.py detects which case applies from total_tokens arithmetic per call and adds reasoning at the output rate only when it is not already inside output_tokens.
token_conventions.long_context: Where a provider prices long prompts higher, the tier applies per model call when that call's prompt (input + cache read + cache write) exceeds the threshold. analyze.py applies it per call from the sample's model events.

anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.notes: Cache hits on Opus 5.5 are 0.05x base input. Full 1M context at standard price (no long-context tier). Also the pinned judge for non-Anthropic agents.

openai/gpt-6.1-sol.notes: Short context <=272K input tokens; long context >272K.

openai/gpt-6-luna.notes: Chosen as the small OpenAI model: newest small tier in the models API (gpt-6-luna; gpt-5.4-mini is a generation older at $0.75/$4.50).

google/gemini-3.1-pro-preview.notes: Output price includes thinking tokens. No per-token cache write charge; explicit-cache storage ($4.50/1M tokens/hour) is not used by Inspect's implicit caching and is not modelled. The only current Pro text model in the Gemini models API (gemini-pro-latest is an alias).

google/gemini-3.8-flash.notes: Introductory price through 2026-12-31; doubles to $1.50/$7.50 (cache $0.15) from 2027-01-01. Runs after that date need the new price. No prompt-length tier.

grok/grok-4.7.notes: Long-context tier applies at >=200K prompt tokens. Reasoning tokens billed at the full completion price; Inspect's grok provider reports them outside output_tokens.

openrouter/deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro-0813.source: https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models (model-level listed pricing); per-provider prices at https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models/deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro-0813/endpoints
openrouter/deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro-0813.notes: ESTIMATE. OpenRouter bills the routed provider's price, which varied across 19 providers on 2026-10-03 (input $0.176-$1.65, output $1.70-$4.95 per 1M; the first-party DeepSeek endpoint is $0.66/$1.98 with time-of-day peaks). Recorded price is OpenRouter's listed model price. To make this exact, pin a provider in the run (-M provider='{"order":["DeepSeek"],"allow_fallbacks":false}') and replace these numbers with that provider's row. Open weights: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813 on Hugging Face.

openrouter/google/gemini-3.1-pro-preview.notes: Output price includes thinking tokens. No per-token cache write charge; explicit-cache storage ($4.50/1M tokens/hour) is not used by Inspect's implicit caching and is not modelled. The only current Pro text model in the Gemini models API (gemini-pro-latest is an alias).
openrouter/google/gemini-3.1-pro-preview.note: Same model via OpenRouter (served by Google); OpenRouter list price $2/$12 per 1M tokens on 2026-10-04, matching Google's.

openai/gpt-5.5.notes: Pinned judge for Anthropic agents (bench/graders.py). Judge cost is reported separately and is not part of agent cost. Long-context tier not checked (judge prompts are short).
